goals: Maintain the faithful unofficial Minecraft Java 26.2 Fabric port of Dramatic Doors while preserving its upstream namespace, IDs, resources, and behavior.
Preserve tall and short door semantics, including true three-block tall doors, optional integrations, and established material-specific behavior.
scope: Preserve exact accepted C7 provenance while maintaining C8 and later narrow successors from the reconstructed 26.2 source lineage.

Preserve facing, hinge, open and powered synchronization, placement, breaking, drops, collision, pathfinding, waterlogging, copper weathering and waxing, recipes, resources, configuration, and compatible AI and mixin behavior.

Preserve the accepted Minecraft 26.2 recipe encoding and load conditions plus the Macaw initialization, property-optional waterlogging, weathering-registration, and mixin-selector compatibility fixes without extending optional integration scope.

exclusions: Feature additions, behavior redesign, identity changes, and any claim that this unofficial Workbench port is an upstream release.

The NeoForge module and the currently excluded Fabric datagen, Create adapter, and direct Japanese-door mixin production surfaces unless a later explicit compatibility task restores them against matching dependencies.
Minecraft deployment, runtime-slot changes, accepted physical Workbench stack changes, protected gameplay-instance access, and Test Instance Manager changes during this migration.
Legacy administrative narratives, branches, tags, snapshots, global status databases, deployment records, and failed historical binaries.
